title: Burlington Trampoline and Tumbling
specs: Birthday party participants aged 4 to 11 years old
Parent & Tot children from crawling age to 5 years old
Parents must supervise children at all times in Parent & Tot
Birthday parties for 10 participants; up to 5 additional at $20 each
Field trips include up to 16 participants; $7.50 per additional participant
includes: Use of party room and tables and chairs
Gymnastics Ontario insurance fee included in drop-in price
gap: Exact prices for recreational classes and summer camp not stated
blurb: Guests participate in gymnastics, tumbling, trampoline activities, and ninja zone games. They offer birthday parties, drop-in parent & tot sessions, PD day camps, summer camps, and recreational classes. Programs are led by certified coaches in a safe environment.
extraNote: Birthday party cancellations more than 3 weeks before event are fully refundable; within 3 weeks 50% refundable with $150 deposit retained · Refunds for recreational classes only up to 1 week before start date; no refunds after classes start · No make-up classes for missed sessions; credits or reschedules if club cancels · Payment due at time of enrolment; 2% surcharge on credit card payments · Gym closure due to weather notified by email · No refunds or credits once camp week begins; minimum 7 days notice for refunds or credits
